note: Checked-in second opinions: anonymized samples tied to demo evidence only. No customer data.

bay:case1.body: Agrees with the module-suspect direction: with the harness proven by hand and the car behaving the same with the module in or out, the module is the standing suspect. The ending lives or dies on the donor set coming from one car with the exact index match, since a wrong-index donor already failed once.
bay:case1.title: Second opinion: silent module
bay:case1.watch: If a harness pin reads wrong on recheck, the suspect changes back to wiring.

bay:default.body: The plan reads sensibly from the evidence shown, but there is not enough recorded yet to lean. Keep recording pass or fail per step and ask again once the trail has something to judge.
bay:default.title: Second opinion
bay:default.watch: One recorded result on the top-ranked test would change this call.

yard:default.body: The grade follows its visible rule inputs, but a second angle or a shop-entered comp would settle the uncertain inputs. Until then this grade is provisional, not sure money.
yard:default.title: Second opinion
yard:default.watch: Whatever input is unknown above: fill that one first.

yard:p_headlight.body: Agrees with B: worth it if you are standing there. The visible condition supports interest but the inputs do not yet support pull-and-list-now confidence, so B is the honest grade.
yard:p_headlight.title: Second opinion: headlight
yard:p_headlight.watch: A second frame confirming the lens, or a sourced comp, would move this to A or C.
